text: dsh-just-settings 是面向 DSH Web 客户端的界面插件：把侧边栏底部的 More 入口替换为直接打开设置的按钮。它通过注册 settings.launcher 插槽提供单击跳转，按钮随侧栏展开和折叠状态调整，并显示本地化的中英文标签。插件提供设置按钮、图标回退和主题样式。适合希望从侧栏快速进入设置、减少菜单操作的 Web 用户。源码没有实现外部服务调用或 API 密钥配置。

dsh-just-settings is a DSH Web plugin that replaces the sidebar’s More menu with a one-click Settings button. It registers in settings.launcher, supports expanded and collapsed sidebars, and provides English and Chinese labels. No API key or external service is defined in the source.
想把 DSH 侧边栏的 More 菜单换成直接打开设置的按钮
让 DSH Web 界面少一步点击就能进入设置
I want a sidebar button that opens DSH settings in one click.
dsh-just-settings 的功能「侧栏直达设置」：在 settings.launcher 插槽注册一个设置按钮。点击按钮调用打开设置的回调，侧栏展开时显示文字，收起时保留图标按钮。

dsh-just-settings README · dsh-just-settings：A tiny, UI-only plugin for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web client. It replaces the sidebar footer's **More** menu with a single **Settings** button.

| Stock DSH | With `dsh-just-settings` |
| --- | --- |
| Click **More** → menu with Settings, Feedback and Sign in | Click **Settings** → the settings panel opens |

No second-level menu is rendered, so the account menu's **Sign in** and **Feedback** entries disappear along with it.

dsh-just-settings README · Why：The stock launcher is an account menu that also happens to contain Settings. If you use an API key or another model provider, that menu is mostly a detour: the only entry you need is Settings. This plugin keeps that one action and removes the rest — one button, one click, no menu.

dsh-just-settings README · Requirements：- DeepSeek Harness **Web** UI
- DSH `0.2.1-rc.2` (the version this plugin was written and tested against)

dsh-just-settings README · Install：Install the bundle into the profile that serves your Web UI. The examples use the `web` profile; replace it with the profile you actually run.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lof6yo/dsh-just-settings
```

Restart `dsh web` and reload the page if the launcher does not change immediately. DSH normally hot-applies a newly installed client bundle.

dsh-just-settings README · From a local clone：```sh
git clone https://github.com/lof6yo/dsh-just-settings.git
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-just-settings
```

dsh-just-settings README · How it works：- The package is a DSH bundle. `package.json` declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and a `dsh.client` Web entry.
- `cordis.patch.yml` inserts one loader row for the package.
- The browser half registers a component into the `settings.launcher` slot at priority `-1`.
- `settings.launcher` is a **single** slot. DSH renders the occupant with the lowest priority, and the shipped account launcher registers at `0`, so this plugin shadows that launcher instead of deleting anything.
- The component is a plain button. It calls the slot's `openSettings` prop, uses the shipped settings icon from the shared primitives module, and uses DSH theme tokens for its styling.
dsh-just-settings README · How it works：The plugin has no host-side code. It makes no network requests, writes no storage, and reads no account or credential data.

dsh-just-settings README · Compatibility and trade-offs：- **The whole account launcher is replaced.** The sidebar no longer shows an avatar or the account (sign-out) menu, even when signed in. The Settings → Account page is provided by DSH and is unaffected.
- Actions that are only reachable from that menu (**Sign in**, **Feedback**) are no longer reachable from the sidebar. That is the intended behavior.
- The button mirrors the stock Settings trigger geometry (42 px row, 36 px collapsed-rail button) and follows the sidebar's expanded/collapsed width.
- If a future DSH release changes the `settings.launcher` contract or registers another launcher at priority `-1`, the plugin may need an update.

dsh-just-settings README · Uninstall：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-just-settings
```

Reload the page (or restart `dsh web`). The stock **More** menu returns.

dsh-just-settings README · Development：The source is plain JavaScript; there is no build step.

| Path | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `package.json` | package, bundle and client manifests |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | inserts the loader row |
| `client.js` | browser half: slot registration, button, styles and copy |
| `index.js` | host half (empty) |
| `locale/en.json`, `locale/zh.json` | plugin display metadata |
| `icon.svg` | plugin icon |

Syntax check:

```sh
node --check client.js
```

dsh-just-settings README · Development：A running DSH watches installed bundle files and reloads a changed client module. When the plugin is installed from a linked local checkout, edits to `client.js` apply without restarting the host. Add the package through `dsh plugin` (or your Plugins page) rather than editing the profile's `package.json` by hand.
dsh-just-settings README · Privacy：This plugin is UI-only. It does not collect telemetry, contact any server, modify credentials, or persist anything.
